name: Aisha
bio: Drawing buildings by day, failing at pottery by night. Will take you to the good coffee place, not the busy one.

prompts.question: The way to win me over is
prompts.answer: Send me a photo of a staircase you thought was beautiful. I am completely serious.

prompts.question: My simple pleasures
prompts.answer: The first ten minutes of a cycle ride before I remember I am unfit.

prompts.question: I geek out on
prompts.answer: Concrete. Specifically the Barbican, which I will defend at length.

name: Tomás
bio: I cook for a living so I will absolutely judge where we eat, but kindly. Sunday roasts are my love language.

prompts.question: My most controversial opinion
prompts.answer: Coriander is not divisive, you are all just wrong.

prompts.question: A perfect Sunday looks like
prompts.answer: Market at nine, cooking by noon, asleep on the sofa by four.

prompts.question: Dating me is like
prompts.answer: Having a friend who always knows a place. The place is usually a bakery.

name: Priya
bio: I will show you photos of other people's dogs within four minutes of meeting you. Fair warning.

prompts.question: Two truths and a lie
prompts.answer: I have been bitten by a parrot, I can solve a Rubik's cube, I have never seen Titanic.

prompts.question: I am looking for
prompts.answer: Someone who will do the cold water swim and complain the whole way, like me.

prompts.question: My love language is
prompts.answer: Bringing you a pastry without asking what kind you wanted.

name: Dylan
bio: Teach history, play five-a-side badly, read more than I watch. Looking for someone to argue about films with.

prompts.question: I am weirdly attracted to
prompts.answer: People who finish the books they start. I have fourteen on the go.

prompts.question: Best travel story
prompts.answer: Missed a train in Lisbon, stayed four more days, no regrets.

prompts.question: Together we could
prompts.answer: Win the Tuesday quiz at the Mason's. I have the history round covered.

name: Lena
bio: Freelance, which means I am either very free or completely unavailable. Plants, risograph prints, long walks.

prompts.question: My simple pleasures
prompts.answer: A new sketchbook and absolutely no plan for it.

prompts.question: Do not hate me if I
prompts.answer: Take a photo of your hands. It is a drawing thing, not a weird thing.

prompts.question: I spend way too much on
prompts.answer: Pens. I have a system. The system is not working.

name: Marcus
bio: I fix people's backs and then tell them to stop sitting like that. Runner, slow cook, terrible singer.

prompts.question: A life goal of mine
prompts.answer: Run a marathon on every continent. Currently one down, which is a start.

prompts.question: I will not shut up about
prompts.answer: My tomatoes. It has been a very good year for the tomatoes.

prompts.question: Pick my karaoke song
prompts.answer: Whatever you choose, I will do it badly and with total commitment.

name: Yuki
bio: I mix records in a windowless room, so please take me outside. Film photography and very long dinners.

prompts.question: The hallmark of a good relationship is
prompts.answer: Comfortable silence. I spend all day listening to things very closely.

prompts.question: My ideal first date
prompts.answer: A walk with no destination, then whichever place looks warmest.

prompts.question: I geek out on
prompts.answer: Room acoustics. I can tell you why your flat sounds strange.

name: Sofia
bio: Shift work means my weekends are random. Bring snacks and patience. I am very good at staying calm.

prompts.question: I am known for
prompts.answer: Being unreasonably competitive about the cryptic crossword.

prompts.question: Give me travel tips for
prompts.answer: Anywhere I can swim outdoors and eat something fried afterwards.

prompts.question: My most used emoji is
prompts.answer: The little moon. I work a lot of nights.

name: Omar
bio: I build bridges, which is a great metaphor and also just my job. Chess, cold weather, bad puns.

prompts.question: My most controversial opinion
prompts.answer: The Thames has too few bridges and I will bring charts.

prompts.question: Teach me something about
prompts.answer: Anything you know more about than me. I will take notes, genuinely.

prompts.question: A perfect night in
prompts.answer: Chess, something slow in the oven, and no phones on the table.

name: Robin
bio: I will recommend you a book based on one thing you said offhand. It will be the right book.

prompts.question: Unusual skills
prompts.answer: I can find any book in the shop in under a minute, including the ones misfiled by customers.

prompts.question: My simple pleasures
prompts.answer: A heron on the canal. Every single time, I stop walking.

prompts.question: I am looking for
prompts.answer: Someone to share the allotment with. Half the beans are yours.
